Katie is the best teacher I've had here so far! She is so kind, understanding, and down-to-earth. She lets you write about what you are passionate about and interested in and lets you have a lot of control over the class. Absolutely loved her and highly recommended

Katie is AWESOME. She gives free rein to write about what you want, and the texts are interesting enough. The level of discussion depends on your peers, but she does a great job of breaking down the readings and analyzing them for us to understand. She also brought in cookies and donuts!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Katie is the best! She makes class not learning because we have to, but instead learning because we want to. She is so kind, and creates a classroom environment where we all can support our peers, and grow together as English students. I would recommend everyone take ENG125 with her for your FYWR—she is by far the best lecturer I've had @ UMich.
She's the best!

Katie is an amazing teacher and one of my favorites at this school! She truly loves English and teaching but is also super understanding of your workload, other classes, and commitments. I highly recommend her!
Made class super enjoyable, super understanding and helpful with every assignment. Wish I could keep taking her class!

This class is so fun! She gives great feedback, and is very kind about it. The texts in this class are very interesting to read. She tells a bunch of stories which are super funny. I highly recommend taking this class.
Great teacher and even better human. English 125 GOAT.

Such an amazing teacher. Katie is so chill and gives so much flexibility. Even though you could just not do anything in this class, she still makes it so that if you actually care and put effort into the course, you'll get so much out of it. She's so smart, and I love her approach to structuring Eng 125 around freeform critical analysis.

Katie Harms is the best English lecturer I've ever had. Her class material is super fun and she really inspires me to write well about topics I've never had any interest about. Her feedback on all of my essays are so well-thought out and I could tell she spent a lot of time just to give me detailed tips on what could be improved.

Katie Harms is my favorite professor i've ever had. She's so funny and relaxed and she bakes cookies for us too!!!

This was honestly an easy class and she made it more enjoyable. If she teaches Eng 325 I would take it with her.

I can't lie Professor Harms might be the best teacher I've ever had at UMich. Not only is she incredibly helpful with feedback but also genuinely cares about her students. And the best part is that her class is very relaxed. Definitely take English125 with her, you won't regret it!
She is a great, excellent professor. The feedback that she gave back on our essay is very good. She is funny and chill. Recommend this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: She made me love writing! With her guidance, I could explore different thoughts and take a deep dive with my paper. She gives us engaging materials and themes to write about, and 1000% recommend her class to anyone who has a bunch of ideas they haven't yet been able to articulate or organize like I did. So grateful to have had her this semester.
Best teacher, very nice teacher, I would highly recommend taking. Gives good feedback on essays and is willing to go out of her way to help.
Professor Harms gives very good feedback and is really going to improve your writing. Best professor!
Amazing teacher, super funny in class and gives great feedback on essays. Take her for English 125!!!

If you ever see Katie listed for English 125, MAKE SURE YOU CHOOSE HER. You absolutely won't regret it. TRUST ME. This was my favorite class during my first semester. The class is open and welcoming, with very few restrictions. Most importantly, your ideas and perspectives genuinely matter in her classroom.

Katie is a great teacher who genuinely cares about teaching her students and improving their writing. Her class is very self-placed and not to demanding so you actually are able to learn while not being too stressed out with work.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Awesome teacher, would definitely take again in the future if I can. Writing papers in her class is actually enjoyable since the feedback she gives you is great. Funny and cares about how you do in the class
accessible outside of class and very straightforward. grades based off improvement which is very neat since if you put in effort you can always get a good grade
Best Professor at the University!

Katie is 100% the best professor I've had at UMich! She's funny, understanding and very supportive. The articles and books we read were short but engaging. I enjoyed our class discussions as well. She wasn't a harsh grader and her feedback was very useful on the essays. I would definitely take her class again!!

She is the best professor in the University! Definitely take Katie Harms' class if you are taking ENG 125. She is super cool and you will have fun learning English. I had a blast ! Absolutely no complaints from taking this class. It was a fabulous experience.

I really enjoyed her class; she had a clear understanding of meaningful assignments vs busywork, unlike any professor I've had before. I never felt overworked in her class; every assignment felt like it had meaning and purpose. She encouraged critical thought, and she's one of the most understanding, genuine, and kind teachers I've ever had.

Katie is so amazing!! Love her she's so so funny, I'm always chuckling in the back corner. You get what you put into the class, if you want to become a better writer she will most certainly help you become one. Gives great feedback, and makes yummy cookies!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Made class engaging because she's funny in whatever she does- made me want to come to class. Very clear about expectations about assignments and papers and provides genuine and helpful feedback. Watched interesting movies to write one along with interesting texts. Brings in snacks :)

Katie was fantastic. Class was fun and engaging and the content was interesting. Not too much homework, unless you didn't do your work in class. I would recommend taking English 125 with Katie. If you lock in and do your work, you should have little to no homework.

Katie was an amazing teacher, and she offered so much help to you if you needed it! I always knew exactly what I needed to do to score highly on an assignment. I really enjoyed the books, and movies that she made us watch. She was very funny, and I always wanted to show up to class. If you have to take english 125 take it with Katie!!
One of the best english classes I have taken. Builds creativity rather than strictly grading off of rubric.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Harms will teach you to write like you haven't before, and it is awesome to learn how to think critically.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Katie was great! you'll be lucky to have this professor for English 125.

Katie is a passionate, dedicated teacher, who clearly cares about her class. You choose the difficulty of this class. I wanted to write the best short story I could, "Somewhere, Perhaps",--so I chose a higher difficulty than what many others may have felt. The purpose of this class was to strengthen your creative writing--and she greatly helped.

Very good professor, gives detailed feedback, English 223 is a fun class, reasonable course load for the topic. The professor is fun and encourages discussion and the course material is engaging. The grading is fair and criteria is clear.

Best English professor at Umich! Made students and class discussions comfortable. She's a teacher that truly understands what's important regarding writing, and I feel like I've grown as a writer this semester more so than in any other class.

Katie always wanted all of us to succeed and gave us the proper tools to go forward with their writing outside of class. She cares about each one of her students and gave everyone a safe space for their ideas. I would take this class with Katie every semester if I could.

She's so lovely, hilarious and relatable. Very honest and gives great feedback if you wanna become a better writer, generous grader if you put in the right effort. She's very understanding and is great at getting to know her students.

Professor Harms is one of the best professor I've had at umich. I had her for english last year and it was the easiest class I've ever taken, super easy grader and clearly wants her students to do well. Hilarious dry humor too. Highly recommend her for english classes
Professor Hoeffner was extremely boring and monotone, however his exams are very easy and he prepares students for them well. I would take it again especially because attendance is not mandatory.

He is a good lecturer. He interacts with students and has us try different things. As long as you pay attention and attend most lectures and discussions you will do fine on the exam. I personally didn't read the textbook and still did well in the class.
Not helpful lectures, hard to understand. Lectures are not recorded and slides does not come in clutch.

He's a nice guy, but lectures can be a slog, and you can self-study while still getting the same learning experience. The weekly quizzes were kinda lame sometimes. Make sure you do well on the exams because they're basically your entire grade!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: hoeffner is great but lectures are very much based on slides. as long as you read textbook you are ok

This course was one of the worst courses I have ever taken. DO NOT TAKE THIS COURSE if you don't have to, especially with this profesor. He just read of the slides (that did not convey information well), he made every single topic boring and monotonous. In exams the questions are stated in a long and convoluted way that make little sense.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Lectures were awful: he reads off the slides word-for-word, jumping around from topic to topic. Save yourself the effort and skip all lectures. It's 10x faster to just read the powerpoint and self-study. The exams are straight forward if you know your stuff, but 3 exams are basically your whole grade. The weekly quizzes were also annoying.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Overall the material of this class was very interesting, but he was not a good professor at all. During the lecture he reads straight off of the slides and does not bother going into more detail about what the slides have to say. The lectures are pointless. I spent the entire semester teaching myself the class. Papers are easy, but exams are hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Moves a little quick, but he's not as boring as people say. Grading system is not the best, heavy emphasis on exams, and some questions on said exams can be ultra specific. Discussion sections are also not my favorite, the weekly quizzes can be more difficult than they should be. Attend and pay attention in lecture, and you'll be fine.

Dr. Hoeffner isn't particularly lacking, but overall the course is mediocre. There are no lecture recordings, and he reads word for word from the slides, which are not well-designed. The actual teaching will be done by GSIs. The study guides are horrible - 4 pages w/ a lot of material not even tested, so it's a total gamble of what to study.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: The slides are really not very helpful, the class itself is very boring. CLass depends on the GSI , your GSI is the one deciding the grades, the assignments make no sense. Overall, the class is super dysfunctional and do not take it with this proffessor.

Dr. Hoeffner makes the ULWR so manageable! His lectures at the beginning of each class prepare you well for quizzes, and each paper goes over a different section of an APA style paper to report experimental results. The last paper entails writing every section for a chosen study that you conduct with groups. Couldn't recommend this class more!!

I got an ok grade, + Dr. Hoeffner is very nice! But, the study guides he gives are very long (3-5 pages of terms), so they take A LOT of time. He goes through lectures fast and isn't always clear with material. Discussions are ok, but the weekly quizzes are hard. The wording can be VERY odd, resulting in confusion and missed points, same for exams.

Grade is determined by 3 exams worth 75% of grade. Other 25% is discussion section which has weekly quizzes. Not very hard. Reason I got my grade is because I didn't study as well as I should've. Not homework heavy. Recommend this class!
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Horrible not nice and doesn't care about students

Hoeffner's lectures move quickly, so attending is a must. The exams focus heavily on memorizing terms, but using study tools like quizzes and unstuck ai can help prep efficiently. Overall a manageable class if you put in the work.

Hoeffner made the ULWR so easy! He walked through each section of the research paper with very straight forward explanation of what he expected from us. At the end you do a research project (can do with a group) and present it (very short). Every class you do a lab and can leave early if you finish and work in groups. Very knowledgable & kind guy!

Exams were 40 MC but the study guides given were 3-5 pages long with various terms listed. The very first lecture I was already irritated by how fast he goes because I could not finish my notes. You are simply told to know the terms and then the exam asks you difficult questions applying the concepts (that were never discussed).
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: he goes very fast in lecture and does not record them so u have to show up. papers were very easy as were the weekly quizzes in section but exams required a lot of time to study as each review sheet had 4-6 pages full of terms to memorize. some questions on the exams were worded weird and Hoeffner was often unable to answer students' questions

The online grading was very confusing and they did not let us know about our grade to the end. He goes very fast during lecture and does not record them meaning if you miss them it will be hard to get the information. Material itself was pretty average as long as you studied all the terms.

This class is VERY heavy on exams. He goes through the slides quickly. The exams are 40 questions, but the study guides can consist of up to 250+ terms so be prepared to memorize a lot. Also two very short essays. Search on quizlet for study sets that are already made to save you time! (I made 3)!

nice guy but he talks so fast it is impossible to keep up with him and the lecture notes. I went into the first test thinking it was going to be fairly easy but he writes his multiple choices so that there is often a seemingly correct trick answer. The class is still overall fairly easy, just expect to have to study a bit for the tests.
Very easy class and tests, lectures were engaging and fun.

Hoeffner's class was very meh and non-remarkable. The exams aren't hard but they are way easier if you just go to class and listen, even though attendance isn't mandatory. As a lecturer, he's not boring, but went through the material very slowly. Easy A if you put a little effort in, keep up with the material, and show up to discussion
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: All memorization for exams. Otherwise, pretty easy. Also, not the best about trigger warnings when it comes to heavy topics.

Dr. Hoeffner was an okay lecturer. He just read off the slides, so it sometimes got boring. This class is mostly graded based off of tests so you have to do well on those in order to get a good grade.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Class attendance is completely optional because the slides are posted online. The exams cover a lot of things not mentioned in the lecture so pay attention to the study guides. The class is all memorization so do not take it if you cannot memorize 200 terms before each exam.

Gives little clarification about material. Does not record lectures, therefore if you miss too bad. In addition, the slides posted are different from the slides in class so attendance is importat.The only points in the class are from the three exams, (300 points) and from the discussion section (100 points).
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: These lectures are some of my favorite to attend. The videos and little experiments we do in class are so much fun, and Prof. Hoeffner seems to really enjoy teaching the subject. I've only had one exam so far but am on pace for an A/A+, and my only complaint was that there was only 1 practice exam and the questions are pretty random.
Refuses to put lecture recordings up even when students are quarantined, lectures are all over the place and unorganized, making it hard to follow along, especially since he rushes through them.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: There are a lot of new terminologies in this class. And he likes to give examples to explain them, which is good. But I would also like concrete definitions to those terminologies which in many cases are not given. Also his voice is a monotone and boring after a while.

The lectures were asynchronous and I slowly stopped watching them. The weekly quizzes are easy if you know your stuff though. Thankfully I took AP Psych just last year so I knew what he was talking about, but his lectures can sometimes be all over the place and just plain confusing. My GSI for this class also didn't help in any way.

The lectures were asynchronous, and I mainly relied on them to prep for exams (there were 2). Had discussion every Friday so there were quizzes every Friday. Pretty simple class, so long as you watch the lectures, youll be fine. Didnt really use the textbook though. Professor Hoeffner also doesnt explain material that well.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Hoeffner is one of the kindest professors I've had - he really wants his students to do well in his class. I didn't like his lectures at all, but attendance isn't mandatory so after I while I stopped showing up & just read the slides. He gives a detailed review guide for all 3 exams & it's easy to ace them just based on those.

His lectures are the most boring thing ever. He does not teach anything he just reads the slides. Read the entire book or you will not pass. The questions on tests he literally just pulls out of his literally no where not out of anywhere that you would think. If you have the option do not take it with this professor.

Prof Hoeffner is awesome, if you need a lab requirement for the BCN major I would really recommend this class! For someone who hates writing papers, I thought the assignments were very doable and he always explained exactly what he wanted to see in our papers. Super nice guy, funny, helpful, and he would let us out early alot.
Doesn't teach anything but the slides in lecture and doesn't answer questions properly. tests are based half on the textbook and on stuff he doesn't even mention in class.
Very unclear in both lectures and slides.

Psych 111 with Hoeffner was the worst class I've taken at UofM. He reads straight from the lecture slides and doesn't explain things well at all. The weekly quizzes are hard and the discussions are pointless. We didn't even cover some of his questions on exams or the questions would be about very specific material we barely covered. Worst class!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Hoeffner tries to crack a lot of jokes in lecture - some funny, some not. As long as you show up to all of the lectures and actively listen while taking notes, it is very easy to get an A in this class. You have weekly quizzes in discussion which can be difficult, but just study the vocab from the book for that week and you'll do fine.

Hoeffner was fine. His lectures are incredibly boring and he literally just reads of the lecture slides which he posts online, so you literally don't need to go to lecture if you read the book/lectures. Quizzes every discussion section but they were super easy, only 6 questions each. The class could've been way more interesting.

Seems like he's used to teaching higher level classes, but still obviously knowledgeable in the topic. The class was easy if you fill out the study guide, and everything was interesting to learn about. Lectures can sometimes be boring but aren't necessary to attend
Boring lectures, mandatory discussion attendance and weekly quizzes, need to read the textbook because his lectures don't cover everything on the exam, medium difficulty.

Smart, nice guy but he talks fast and can be hard to follow. Boring lectures that rely heavily on slides, don't bother with the book. A lot of material covered in a short period. 3 tests determine your entire grade and questions can be unnecessarily convoluted. Do poorly on a test and your grade tanks. This class ruined my 4.0. Avoid if you can.
Great professor who is very passionate about what he is teaching. Looked forward to going to class. I would definitely recommend taking 240 with Hoeffner.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Hoeffner's lectures are boring, but the material is straightforward enough and the class is easy, especially because he provides practice exams, review sheets, and an end-of-semester extra credit opportunity. My only gripe beyond the boredom is that the weekly quizzes in section can be a pain.

Very easy course with easy material, but Jim does not teach it well. His lecture slides are not organized and focus on information that is rarely on the test. Pretty boring and dry lectures. Will give exam review sheets and an extra credit option, easy to get an A. Weekly quizzes in discussion. Hope that you have a good gsi, Jim doesnt teach well

He's not a bad guy, but he is a terrible lecturer. His lectures are very dry. If you're actually interested in the subject material, I would recommend a different professor, but if you're looking for an easy A and credit, he's your best bet.

He makes this class about the basics more entertaining. I got 100 on the first exam so I stopped reading the book and still got As on the last two exams. Just go to lecture and pay attention and you will be fine. Also, if you took any psychology in high school this class will be incredibly easy. It is mostly just memorization.

Hoeffner's nice and all, though his lectures are really boring unless you find a way to engage yourself. I wouldn't take a class with him again on purpose, but if there were no other options I wouldn't be upset.

Hoeffner is generally understanding as a person and a professor. He responds to emails and cares about his students. However, his lectures are kind of boring unless you really make an effort to listen. The PSYCH111 material is very interesting, especially for psych majors. Go to discussion sections, they have quizzes that really affect your grade.

Hoeffner is an okay lecturer. He reads directly off the slides, which is boring, but you can tell he cares about psych and what he's teaching. The class itself is really easy. If you're taking this for your major Hoeffner is an easy A and really great, but if you're taking it for fun, it's better if you have a different professor.

Some lectures were more interseting than others depending on the topic. Lecture slides are posted online if you cannot make it to lecture, though discussion is a must. Overall good class, and he's a really nice guy.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I've really enjoyed being Dr. Hoeffner's student. Although his lectures are definitely boring and dry, he knows what he's talking about. You can tell that he's passionate and he does his best to get through to material. I love Dr. Hoeffner because he's extremely reasonable. He makes study guides, easy exams, and is overall a super nice guy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Very mediocre professor. It's a pretty easy A, but the lectures are very boring; he just reads directly off the slideshow most of the time.
Dr. Hoeffner is was a good choice. Three 40 question exams and 2 papers.
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: If you had 240 with Hoeffner and don't want to take 341 with him you'll be making a mistake. He makes the class interesting, gives you a lot of autonomy on your project, and the class always gets out early. On top of that its very easy to get an A.
James is good if you're looking for an A, but be ready to memorize a lot. Just do the slides. Book is definitely not necessary.

Dr. Hoeffner is by far and large the worst lecturer I have had at the Univeristy. He moves fast and reads directly off the slides. His powerpoints are long and it is easy to lose interest during his lecture. However, the content is easy and the class was a breeze, all of my problems lay within the proffessor not the class.

The course is a little dry and it's not helpful that Hoeffner reads directly off the slides. The three tests make up 80% of the grading in the course so if you do poorly on one exam it can tank your grade. Luckily he gives you a comprehensive study guide and practice exam a week before the exam. He can be really funny sometimes.
Psych 240 is an easy class, but Hoeffner does not make the course interesting and his lectures drag on.  Fine class to fulfill Psych Major requirement, but don't take this class for fun.

I really enjoyed the material of Psych 240 when studying it, however, Dr. Hoeffner's lectures were not great.  The powerpoints were extremely long and Hoeffner spends a long time on the easy material and speeds through the harder stuff.  Don't spend hundreds of dollars on a new textbook because it will be barely touched...

This class was a pretty easy A if you went about it the right way. Lectures aren't necessary but some comments by Hoeffner are not on the powerpoints and sometimes show up on the test. Grade is basically just the three exams and are all very easy as long as you study the Powerpoints and memorize everything. 5 of the 50 test questions are tricky.

Hoeffner's lectures are pretty boring but you can tell he really cares about the material and he puts in lots of videos and examples to change things up. Plus there's no papers for this class just 3 exams and if you pay attention in lecture and look over your notes you'll be fine

He's not the most exciting lecturer and reads basically word for word off the powerpoint. While lectures could help you depending on your learning style, for others they're not totally necessary. There's not much reading from the textbook either. As long as you review the powerpoints and important terms well, you should get a solid grade on exams.
Seems like a really nice, and intelligent, guy. Takes a little while to get back to emails, but his answers are usually helpful.

Reads right from the powerpoints.  I'm prepping for the first exam and I feel like I know nothing.  Gives reviews and practice exams so hopefully those are somewhat helpful.  Very boring lectures though.  If it wasn't so far into the semester, I would've switched out.

Lectures are extremely boring. Luckily slides are posted online. Quizzes every week in section so be on time. No papers!! Extra credit just for doing the practice exams. If you have to take 240, taking it with Hoeffner isn't a bad choice.
A boring lecturer, he is very intelligent but it feels like when he is teaching he's going through a rehearsed script. Hard to pay attention to sometimes but overall an easy course.

I felt that his lectures were boring and his voice was quite monotone. He tends to reference one image or example to illustrate a concept. But the GSI sections tended to be a weekly review and clarification rather than intellectual discussion. Though repetitive, it helped me get a good grade.
I've been in this class for 3 days and I already regret taking it w/ him.

The information is very interesting, however, the textbook and the lecture slides tend to vary about half the time, so I suggest going through slides and reading. Attendance not mandatory. Most people quit going after a few weeks because lectures were sometimes a bit dry. 3 non-cumulative exams + weekly quizzes.

Prof Hoeffner is a great. The class was extremely interesting. He provides a lot of help both in and out of class and is extremely understanding of students' needs. The exams are not difficult at all so long that you attended class. Also Ziyong is an AMAZING GSI so try to have her if possible.

Lectures are incredibly boring and his voice is just annoying. The exams are harder than most other psych classes, tons of information on slides that is just all jumbled together and not very organized. One of the worst psych classes I've taken here.

I'm appalled to see positive reviews for Prof. Hoeffner. Teaching style, presentation aesthetic, and disregard for conceptual depth is beyond disappointing. No fluidity in lecture and merely reads off the slides in a hasted manner. Exams demand analysis and detail scarcely found in lecture. Do not take, find another prof, or learn on your own.
Memorize lecture slides and you should receive an A. The first test is fairly easy but don't slack off. Plus the extra credit helps.

Lecture can be a little boring but Hoeffner definitely explains things clearly. He wants students to do well and is super helpful, and even offered a major extra credit opportunity to my class when one test had a lower average. Definitely worth taking it's not a hard class.

Professor Hoeffner isn't a great lecturer (he talks fast and reads directly from slides), but this class is super easy to do on your own. I went to lecture and studied the slides and was completely fine.

I had Hoeffner for 240 and didn't love him, but 341 is VERY different. The class is small, so you have more chance for 1-on-1 interaction. He's very clear about grading, and assignments are pretty simple. Lots of group work, so prepare for that. But the class is VERY easy, and it always lets out early!
I was skeptical after reading the less than positive reviews here but Hoeffner was actually a relatively engagingfunny guy . Exams were really easy and there were no assignmentspapers.
He reads right off the slides, and doesn't give good examples or clear descriptions. When he hands out a study guide, almost none of the information on it was covered in lecture or the book.

He basically reads the slides out loud. Not an exciting lecture, but I  suggest attending anyway to avoid the alternative- the textbook. I got an A+ in the class and all I did was make flash cards for the terms and memorize them. Boring, but effective. He is very approachable with questions if you ask him before/after class or even during an exam.

I've heard that Hoeffner gets a bad rep from Psych 240, but Psych 341 was a blast.  The course is relatively easy.  You rarely ever stay for longer than 1 hour per class.  Hoeffner is helpful and attentive, and grades relatively leniently.  I would definitely take this class for the lab requirements for Psych/BCN.  Learned a lot!

Avoid Hoeffner if you can. His lectures were very dry and boring, and he basically just reads straight off his slides. I didn't feel like I was getting much out of going to the lectures. The exams were tricky and asked some off-the-wall kinds of questions. Overall, it was a frustrating class.
He is extremely boring and never seems to get through any of the lecture slides. Lectures are extremely unorganized. I would not recommend him
Lectures were horribly disorganized, working with powerpoints with over 60 slides.  Definitely a knowledgable guy in his field but not a good teacher.  Avoid if possible.

Lectures are very boring, sometimes hard to understand the professor, need to know details from the slides for exam. Helpful to go to lecture because the posted slides don't have all of the details that he goes over in class

hate this class, his exam questions are not straight forward and are meant to be applied. he gives you a study guide but it doesn't really help. I'm hoping for an A/A- in this class but most difficult psych class i've taken. i would never have taken it if it wasn't required.

Hoeffner doesn't do anything tremendous to make the class exciting, but if you're interested anyways you'll enjoy it. He can go through ppt slides a little fast at times, but for the most part it's very straightforward. I go to every lecture and do a bit of studying before exams and get all As and A+'s.

Absolutely awful. I was really excited for this class but the way he teaches is terrible. He posts lecture slides online but doesn't include all of them so if you don't go to lecture you will miss out on a few. His "study guide" was hardly helpful since it basically said: know everything about anything I ever mentioned.

Hoeffner is the worst.  His lectures are boring, unorganized and unclear.  He expects students to know every facet of every concept he has discussed for exams.  Exam questions are unclear and meant to trick you (a and b, all of the above, a b but not c etc).  Discussion does not help. Definitely not an easy class, avoid him if you can.

I never went to lecture because it was pointless, my time was better spent going through the slides at home. The discussion quizzes and the exams were actually really difficult. I imagine this class would be an easy A if you went to class, which you laugh now, but by the end of the semester there will literally be only a dozen students in lecture.

Attending lecture is useless. His slides are very unorganized and confusing. Discussion is a nightmare because no points are awarded for participation, just the quizzes you take there. His lectures are very boring and tests are of the A,B, C =A and B or D all of the above.

His powerpoints are so unorganized and offer no information. He reads directly off the slides and attendance is not mandatory, thank god, because going to lecture is pointless. Not super hard if you study everything on his review sheets but be ready for tricky questions meant to throw you off. Quizzes every week in discussion.

I took this class thinking it would be interesting. Hoeffner's a nice guy but is not a very interesting lecturer. Reads off of slides barely explaining them and speaks way too fast. The exams are not an easy A, but a doable B+ or A- if you study.

Most ridiculous psych class i have taken. The lectures were boring as can be and the lecture slides contained like 60-70 slides a lecture. Trying to study for this class is a nightmare in my opinion. Take it with someone else if you can.

This is the hardest psych class I took. The material was overwhelming and confusing, and it didn't help that he sped through 70 lecture slides in an hour. I honestly had no idea what I was doing in that class, and unfortunately my GSI wasn't very helpful. Too bad it's required for many people to take this. I wish you good luck.

Understand the material well and uses a no nonsense teacher style. Not the most interesting professor but if you like the subject material you'll quickly learn that he doesn't make over arching claims about psychology and admits there are a lot of limitation to what we know. He will leave you with a solid foundation of what to really expect.

Exams are multiple choice and are very easy. Great professor. He's down to earth and doesn't make miraculous claims about the power of research in psychology and recognizes that it's still a new and budding field of science. No nonsense focus on the course material

Easiest class ever. I didn't pay attention in lecture and put in minimal effort on the short essays, got an A. LOVE IT. The prof was adorable and funny. Now back to studying for classes that require effort..aka ECON 401. :(
So unbelievably boring. But its easy, so there's that. Annoying accent, sounds like Peter from Family Guy. A lot of writing assignments but not too bad.

TERRIBLE professor. Disorganized and reads off the slides which are extremely poorly made. He doesn't even thoroughly understand the material himself. This class will end up being mostly self-taught. He really made an interesting topic rather painful. Take it with someone else if you can.

3 tests, top 2 worth 25%, bottom worth 20%, paper worth 25%, weekly quizzes worth 5% in section (6 questions, grade out of 5) provides good demos but class is often boring and can drag on, hard to stay focused. gives an in depth review guide with every term needed. tests were hard, he gave slight curves and seemed to make tests easier as it went on
Overall a great prof and a really nice guy. Makes lectures fun with examples and gets you involved. Knows the concepts and you're fine.

DO NOT RECOMMEND THIS CLASS. The average for the first mid-term was a B-..And it's not curved. Slides jump in logic. Not helpful if you dont have notes. BUT it's extremely hard to take notes because he talks fast, or slow.. who knows..

Hoeffner is a good professor, sometimes a little disorganized and powerpoints too wordy and lengthy at times. He is a clear orator but class is dry because of the material. Exams are strangely worded and somewhat difficult (b- average for the class...) but overall, I would recommend this class

he's a very boring lecturer while moving way too fast to write notes down at the same time.  not a good combination.  occasionally does cool demos in class but generally i'd wait until a different prof is teaching cog psych to take it if i could do it over...

Not a bad professor, but least favorite psych class so far. Lectures had WAY too many slides! Material is very technical and boring, but prof. does cool demos in class. Maybe I'm just terrible at cogpsych, but the exams are really hard. Didn't help that I had a terrible GSI who was very unhelpful and strict. Wouldn't recommend this class at all.

Unfortunately, the class material is boring, but it was super easy. The class is supposed to run 2 hours, but we were rarely there more than 1 hour. Hoeffner's thick Jersey accent is a little hard to get used to at first, and he goes a bit fast with lecture material, but he's funny and helpful. Also, I never read the book and still aced the quizzes
He was great and his exams are very straightforward.  Your class grade is determined almost exclusively by your GSI but there are 3 exams that are pretty easy except the second exam is harder.

Boring material, can't be helped. Either read the text or go to lecture, doing both is a waste of time. Exams are easy, hope for a not-so-strict gsi for grading papers. Hoeffner is really nice and helpful.
He is from long island and completely useless.  Don't take cogpsych with him.
BORING! but easy! Lots of papers bust very straight-forward. Plus you get to hand in drafts yo your GSIs beforehand and get feedback before handing in a final. Exams (3) are a joke!
Makes class as interesting as can be...boring material. great for an ULWR!!! yes, there are 6 papers but they are 2,2,3,3,4,6 pages- not hard at all.

With 3 tests and 6 papers this test is a lot of work. I was fortunate to have a good GSI (Rika Meyer). Take the rubric given and follow it to a tee and you will do fine. I found the second exam (Stats) very difficult, but Stats is not my thing.
The lecture/exam portion of this class is not bad at all. The papers can add up, but it's ULWR, so it's expected.

The exams are very easy in this class (study a bit more for the stats one). The papers are dependent upon your GSI, but you can turn in drafts... so your almost guaranteed a good grade if you can get the draft in.

don't go to lecture, it's a waste of your time and he is hard to understand. The book is basically useless, maybe just for terms, but this class is all about the GSI. the class has no format and every gsi is different which can get very annoying. the are all hard graders. the tests are easy, just learn the slides...but the papers- annoying

Psych 303 is not a walk in the park. Your grade depends on who your GSI is.  The GSI may have different criteria than another GSI.  Also, my GSI set extra requirements that Hoeffner didn't set.  My GSI was a tough grader. The 2nd exam was more difficult than first 2, mostly cause he rushed through the previous lecture. Otherwise, good lecturer!
I love taking Hoeffner's classes. I've taken 3 of them so far and have enjoyed all of them. He's a cool guy, be sure to take at least one of his classes :)

Had him for Psych 111 and 303 and he is the easiest Psych Prof in the department. Minimal work for 111 and just papers for 303 (your GSI's correct rough drafts for you). His exams are always M.C. and are easy. Hoeff is friendly outside of class too.
class was easy. he looked really nervous - drinking water every 2 minutes, talking at 100mph, and not even noticing that his mike had slipped off his collar. but overall, it was okay.

This class was so easy.  It was the second time he had ever taught this class and didn't really know what he was doing.  He read straight from the lecture slides and pulled all his info on exams from lecture so as lost as u read the slides u would do good, attendence not that important slides online

so easy...i actually think it might have been easier than middle school.  it is a great upper level writing course and just follow the directions for the assignments and you are bound to get an A.  you do not have to read and merely use the "textbook" which is only about 30 pages long to look up terms on the study guide.

Awesome ULWR choice.  I hardly did any work for this class or studied for it, because of my other classes, and still got a solid A.  Write your papers according to the rubric and look up the terms on the study guide at least once and you'll be set.

This class is a good way to fulfill the upper level writing requirement.  For fulfilling the ULWR, it doesn't seem to have as much writing as you'd expect.  The bad thing is that this class is sooo boring.  It makes it very difficult to work up the motivation to go to lecture.  The exams are multiple choice, but can be a bit tricky.

Ridiculously easy class. My roommate and I were both in his lecture, and we stopped going after about the 3rd week into the semester, and we still both got A's in the class. He is a cool guy and his New York-style accent is awesome.
Can be funny at times but lectures are on the dull side.  Very easy multiple choice tests.  Puts all notes on ctools.  Very interesting class.

The class itself is perfect for anyone looking to get into the field of psychology. Dr. Hoeffner is a very helpful professor and his slides and review sheets are perfect. Low workload and as long as you stay on top of the reading the class is a piece of cake.
No Comments
This class is a piece of cake.

Reading his slides, you can cram for the final the night before. Before the exams, Hoffner gives a review sheet that tells you everything you need to ace the test. Reading supplemental materials is not necessary to get an A in the class (at least for me).

Boring and tests were ridiculously stupid multiple choice. When you put 4 answers with one adjective or preposition differing, you may your test impossible for someone how has to deal with 59 other questions the same way in less than 40 mins (yea 40. You waste 10 mins before taking the damn test)
The lectures are so boring and pointless. Don't even go, because you can get the notes off ctools. His tests are not too bad, if you study.
Really nice guy, but can be very boring. He basically just reads teh notes you can get online... thus the lectures are not necessary. Easy course!
His lectures are very interesting

Lectures are boring, but...he posts all lecture notes on the internet. As long as you take the time to print them off and study them, you'll never have to attend lectures (except for exams) and you'll get an easy A!
Easy if you study the materials, but boring.
easy A
SO easy

He is a darling old man, but this class is SO boring that it becomes hard because you never want to go to it.  Don't worry though papers make up for it.  VERY easy class.. great upper level writing requirment choice.
Easy and straightforward.
No Comments

He speaks way too fast!  You cannot understand any thing in lecture and it is a waste of time to go.  He posts all of the lecture notes on line and you can just read those.  Class is a joke and it is easy to get an A.
No Comments
Hoeffner makes the class very easy and exams are basically straight from the notes (available online).  He has a great sense of humor and made lecture very interesting and fun.
cannot recommend him enough I hate english but loved this class

Joseph Harms is an absolutely awesome professor. He is so kind and caring and makes his class very accessible and doable for students. His class is very flexible; you have a lot of space to write about what you want. The class went by very quickly because he made it very engaging. He is definitely the best ENG 125 professor.

Joe is such a kind and caring person, and a wonderful professor! Class was very engaging and open for discussion, readings were interesting, and I felt his enthusiasm for the subject/our participation. It was just major assignments, and as long as you show up and do work, the class itself is easy to get a good grade in. overall amazing, take him!!
Best English teacher I've had. Great guy, makes class engaging and open for discussion. Workload is light, but you still learn a lot
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Joe is one of the greatest professors I've ever had. He is extremely caring and enthusiastic about his subject and will make you a better writer with his constant and thorough feedback. Unless you are purposely trying to fail the class it is impossible to get lower than an A. Regardless, put in the effort and participate, he really deserves it.

One of the best English teachers I've had. If you take advantage of his feedback, you can become a better writer. Regardless, he doesn't grade harshly, and if you write the essays and participate a bit, you will get an A.
This is a great class to take as your FYWR if you aren't an English person
Incredible

He is a super great professor. Seriously, you should take him for any english class. You will get an A if you show up a majority of the time and participate (even just once) a majority of the time. He is super undertstanding and overall just wants people to participate together. SERIOUSLY JUST TAKE HIM.

Joe was just phenomenal. He was so kind and caring, and created such an amazing classroom environment. Grades were very clear, and once you get into a flow, this class is very enjoyable. Truly a fun class.
Great dude. His expectations for essays were low, but we all respected him enough to put adequate effort in the course. I 100% recommend Joe

Joe gives the best feedback, his classes are never boring. He will make you a better writer, this class isn't that hard. There is a lot of reading but that is it, if you listen in class and participate and do the readings you will be fine. You will do really good in the class promise!!
Enjoyed class and writing a lot, would retake

I was warned going into ENGLISH 223 that many of the instructors would be teaching for the first time as graduate students in the Helen Zell program. However, Joe was well-versed and experienced in the classroom and I couldn't have asked for a better instructor. He's funny, he's caring, and great at giving feedback.

Joe is easily the best professor that I've had. He's extremely understanding, humble, and open-minded. He enables his students to be the most creative that they can be and his passion for this subject is extremely clear. Even when a text is boring, he's able to get everyone to participate and talk about it. Definitely would recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Joe was a very nice professor inside and outside of class. He was a really lenient grader. As long as you follow the rubric, ur grade will be totally fine. He's one of my favorite professor that I've taken and I will definitely take this class again as the English requirement.

No matter how good or bad a writer you think you may be, Joe will work with you to ensure you find success. If you come to class every day, are willing to engage in the material, and bring a good attitude, you will find success in this class. He is someone who truly cares about your writing development, but more importantly, you as a person.

I loved taking mr. Harm's class. He gives excellent feedback, and I have never meet another person so good at creating discusion. I was often stunned to hear about just how knowledgable he was on certain reading, and other media we would bring to class. He was, without exagerattion the closest thing I have had, to date, to a perfect professor.

As a CS major who hated English in high school, Joe genuinely renewed my love for writing and this was my fav class this semester. He gives such thoughtful feedback and the things we get to read/discuss/write about are so interesting and deep, which is why I think the assignments for this class feel more rejuvenating than tiring. Can't say enough.

Professor Harms is one of my favorite professors and is incredibly knowledgeable and mindful of students workloads. He created an enthusiastic and supportive class environment and was very respectful when it came to learning accommodations.
Great professor! Super nice and fun! English 125 with him was not a difficult workload and classes were engaging.
I REALLY RECOMMEND THIS CLASS!!!!

I love this professor so much! He is super down-to-earth, genuine, and excellent at giving feedback on our short stories and poems. I highly recommend him! Super talkative and understanding with a genuine love for what he does.

Joe made every class a good time. He is always positive and encourages students to share their thoughts and experiences making class conversation flow very easily. This class is one of my favorites I've taken at Umich and would absolutely take it again. It was very easy to receive an A, just need to go to class and be open to sharing your ideas.

Really great professor and person. He always gave really good feedback on all of our essays and if I had to redo my FYWR I would take it with him again. Just make sure that you do all of the readings before class and you will have a really easy time.

Hands down the best professor you can have for your FYWR course at Michigan. Super caring and nice, and always will give you extensions when needed if you have other obligations. Extremely clear grading criteria for essays and has designated in-class office hours to get feedback on major assignments. Show up prepared each class and you'll be fine.
genuinely a really nice guy. as long as you read before each class and participate you'll be good!

Joe is an extremely interesting, funny, and down-to-earth person and professor. Grading is quite lenient, he just wants to see that you give a crap and you're engaging with your peers and the texts we read in class. Very understanding of conflicts and other things going on outside of class. There's no reason you shouldn't take his class for FYWR.
Great teacher for the FYWR, gives good feedback on all of your essays. As long as you do the homework and try to participate in class, you will be fine. Classes are engaging and you will learn a lot.
Such a great prof for FYWR! He was so kind and caring and highly recommend.

Joe was a great teacher for this class. Not as much homework as expected, and as long as you try to participate in class, you'll be fine. he gives good feedback and you learn a lot as a writer. Would highly recommend for your FYWR.

Professor Harms was a great professor for ENG125. He was super understanding regarding questions about essays and cared about his students. I can't recommend him more for a first year writing class. Awesome professor!
Nice and genuine guy. Very little outside the classroom work and good in class discussions

Highly recommend taking Joe's class for first-year writing. Work/course material can seem a little much at first, but he does a great job of explaining readings, essay expectations, and it's not too bad at the end of the day. Joe is great overall and will give great feedback on all essays.

Joseph is one of the best professors I have had so far at Michigan! His lectures are interesting, and the biggest thing he asks for is genuine participation and engagement. The homework he assigns is always on a reasonable timeline, and he is incredibly understanding with his students. I would highly recommend taking a class with him.

Very good professor. Personable, understanding, and you can tell he really cares about you, your writing, and the material he teaches. His hands literally shake from excitement. If you put in any effort at all you'll get an A. Great guy, great for FYWR.

Joe is honestly one of the best professors I've had at Michigan. He treats his students like real people and genuinely cares about what we think. He also gives amazing feedback that actually helps you grow as a writer. If you ever need an extension or have to miss class, he's very understanding and works with you.

Professor Harms is amazing. He's super caring and understanding, and as long as you put in a good effort you will do just fine. He's easily my favorite professor that I've had thus far, highly recommend taking his class for the FYWR!

Joe is one of the best professors I have had at Michigan so far. He is always super caring and understanding if any situations arise. His ENGLISH 125 course is very interactive and requires consistent participation, but as long as you show up to class and put in a decent effort into the seminars, you will be fine. Take your FYWR with him if you can

Joe was an amazing teacher who is respectful of everyone, caring, and super smart. I find the mark of a good class is when I can actually mark progress in my work, and I certainly improved my writing in this class.

Professor Harms is a great professor. There are 4 essays for the whole semester and you are graded based on essays and peer reviews. You can get extra credit on the peer reviews if you put enough effort in. His class is very enjoyable and he's a really nice guy. Definitely recommend him!

Fantastic professor, clearly cares about each student and wants them to succeed. Little to no homework assignments and essays are graded very fairly. During the drafting process for all the essays, he reviews everyone's introduction paragraphs and select body paragraphs and provides a lot of advice. He allows a lot of individual freedom on essays.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Joe is honestly the best professor. He makes discussions engaging and genuinely cares about your participation and effort. He'll help you succeed if you put in the work. If you want to improve your writing and have productive, thoughtful, yet fun discussions, while always being able to count on his support, Joe is the professor to choose.

Joe was such an awesome professor and I am happy I had the chance to take a class with him. He really remembers what you say in class and gets to know everyone. The class is very low stakes, writing a couple poems and short stories for your classmates to workshop but the conversations are always fun and I would definitely take this class again.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Joe is easily the best professor in the English department. He is so thoughtful and caring and will always try understand any problems. He makes a real effort to get to know you. Class is low stakes and he's very easy going. Again- THE best prof, please take him if you have the chance!! (He's super hilarious and his stories are always so funny).

Joe is amazing, the best prof so far. You learn how to write in a low-stakes environment, and classes are mostly Socratic, and papers are based on a conversation in class. He is such a light! Funny and understanding and very approachable. The small class sizes make the class very close-knit and honestly so fun.  
Would def take him again.
Joseph was very kind, funny, and he grades assignments mostly based off effort. Would recommend for first year writing.
Harms was amazing, super personable guy who made the workload not bad at all. Very fair grader, made discussions easy to pay attention to.

Joe is an amazing professor. ENG223 is workshop-based and you submit two poems and two short stories that the class spends 20 minutes giving feedback on. He has an MFA, but Joe says in every class that his opinion doesn't matter and that published authors aren't automatically better. Great teacher, an even better person. Take a class with Joe!!

Joe was amazing. The class itself with him actually is somewhat fun, which is difficult to do for an english class. What I really want to highlight though is how great of a person Professor Harms is. He's funny, approachable, and genuinely wants the best for you. He's compassionate, and is an amazing professor that somehow made english fun.

Joe's genuinely the picturesque college professor. The course topics are always interesting and engaging. Class discussions are always fun yet informational, and Joe gives excellent feedback. Joe single-handedly improved my writing ability to a level I really didn't think I could get to. Best, funniest, and coolest teacher I've had at U-M no doubt.

Joe is awesome. He is hilarious during in class discussions, and is very good at teaching the stories and movies that he decides to teach. There are only 4 papers during the semester, and he grades them very easily. If you do the work, you will get a good grade in this class.

Very professional, reasonable about things like absences/makeups. The lectures aren't the most helpful, but the labs are fantastic. You get out of them what you put into them, so go the extra mile to prepare. If you're in this class for an easy A, you will HATE it (but you'll get an A). If you're here to learn, you will LOVE it.

Dr. Gottfried, in person, wants students to succeed; she hosts tons of office hours. However, the videos she has posted for the flipped classroom section are oftentimes old and lackluster, and are more important than her good office hours. Additionally, the exams have obscure content or applications of content that you've only seen once before.
Very easy lab, going to lab and the lecture wasn't always fun. But it's an easy A and Dr. Gottfried is very nice and personable.

The class is very easy. SHE is very difficult. I don't think she likes her students.

I pray for her.

Not a nice person overall! Office hours with her is pretty good, she explains things well, but is not understanding at all whatsoever. You could tell her that your grandma just died and she would give you a zero and say that she won't change it until you bring her the corpse as evidence. Also does not provide feedback or even a dang rubric
loved loved her lectures, i think she's really passionate about chem. my gsi however...

Given the nature of Chem230, it is a tough class to begin with. I truly thought that Dr. Gottfried was a great professor, and made an effort to have office hours multiple times a week. The way the class is graded/curved helped a lot of students, but get ready to put in some hours. Personally, I think that this class was easier than Orgo; goodluck!

I enjoyed having Dr. Gottfried! You could tell that she cared about her students & she genuinely enjoyed teaching. However, we would have to rush through lectures because there was a lot of material being presented. If you aren't paying attention, lab may be hard. Attendance is taken w/ iClicker. Your GSI is important, and I loved my GSI, Sean!

Good teacher for Gen Chem lab, explanations for chem topics were great. Her office hours are also nice to go to if you have questions. I wish the lecture pacing was better and the contents more organized to make the pre-lab less tedious.

Dr Gottfried's lectures were extremely useful for the lab as she provided examples for the majority of calculations. However, sometimes her pace was too slow in lecture and, as a result, not all the material got covered. Strictly speaking content, she did a good job explaining labs

I think Professor Gottfried was really nice and was engaging in her lectures for lab. She gives away a lot of information and helpful things for lab during lecture so it's important to write it all down because it makes everything much faster during lab. Your GSI matters and Caroline is the best!!!
She got stuck herself dealing with a calculation in class. That's truly awful.

Chem 125/126 was overall a interesting course, however Gottfried just made some of the labs tedious with the busy work. However, there was little to no work outside of class beside pre-lab quizzes due before each lab. Labs are also very GSI dependent, my sections GSI was little to no help.

CHEM 125/126.
Some labs were fun, some were very tedious. She would show up in labs sometimes to answer questions. She can get side tracked in lecture, but slides are posted online so it's not necessary to go. Your GSI is more important for your grade and experience than Dr.Gottfried is, honestly.

Chem 125/126 was not a horrible lab. Pre-lab was a lot of busy work but it was not difficult. Labs were kind of boring but 100% doable. The lecturers were helpful for data tables, but the slides were posted, so I stopped going and just used those. The pre-lab protocol was enough information to do the lab well.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment:
CHEM125/126
Her lectures spent the majority of the time exploring broader concepts to the lab, which felt like we didn't even talk about relevant lab info until halfway thru the lecture (so with 20 minutes left.) She also showed important tables needed for the lab for a few seconds before moving on without enough time for us to take note

Amy Gottfried showed very little care or respect for me. She failed to answer emails consistently. Her lectures were mildly interesting however she does not care about her students one bit. At one point, she blamed me for a mistake that she made in her class (forgetting to open a quiz on labflow until during spring break, I got a 0/15). Beware.

She is the worst professor I have ever had the misfortune of meeting. She rarely responded to emails on time and would act like her class was the only one that you were taking. For instance, I had another exam in a different class and she accused me of lying about it then made me reschedule it just so I wouldn't be 10 minutes late to her class.

Dr. Gottfried is the sweetest professor ever. She puts in a TON of effort (6-8 hours of OH a week) and somewhat curves your grade to make it look better. Her lectures are very clear and concise and her explanations are amazing. However, her exams are difficult and her responses on piazza are pretty vague. Ask her questions in person instead.

Professor Gottfried is the best chemistry professor I have had at umich. The reverse classroom is so helpful and she is very approachable and clearly explains topics and answers questions. The exams are fair and she adds points for improvement to your overall grade. She is very encouraging and makes a difficult class less scary. Love her :)
Professor Gottfried is an amazing teacher who makes a tough class doable. Her lectures are clear, and she's super accessible. unstuck study was a huge help for study prep.

If you are not good at math you are going to have a hard time in this class. She expects you to already know how to do calculus and does not show sympathy on exams. Theres no way you can even guess on her exams because most of it is calculations and application. She is very dismissive and I would highly recommend taking it somewhere else.

Chem 230 is hard, but Professor Gottfried made it doable. She is by far the best professor I've had at explaining difficult concepts, super patient, and accessible outside of lecture. She cares about students and makes an effort to get to know people, even though the class is quite large. The workload is insane, but she provides plenty of resources
I found Gottfried to be respectful and caring towards students, though her lectures often felt unimportant.

Professor Gottfried is so kind and so caring. She makes an effort to get to know you during lab times even though lecture sections are extremely large classes. She is skilled at relaying information and answering questions and makes topics clear and resources accesible.
Hard course but great professor. Easiest chemistry professor to understand and ask questions to
What a doll! Her class was HARD, but I learned so much. I'm so glad to have taken her class!

Look: this class is difficult and requires a lot of work/effort. But, I think Dr. Gottfried did a pretty good job and was very accessible during office hours and Piazza. Some of the videos did not go in-depth a I would have hoped, but the TIPS sessions were pretty useful. Also, probably the kindest professor on campus!

i had her for chem 125/126 (lab) and her lectures are absolutely useless!! yet she expects you to go to them. they do not help with the lab at all and this class is heavily GSI dependent. avoid if possible
Her active learning sessions are SO helpful! By far my favorite professor at Umich.

while she's a nice teacher, this class is WAY too much work for 3 credits. 5 tests, lectures we have to watch on our own time, homework due basically every other day, quizzes before class... and during "lecture" time it's just students problem solving while she rushes through solutions in the last 5 mins. the best prof for 230, but 230 is awful.

I LOVE Dr. Gottfried!! Best professor ever at Michigan. She loves teaching and her class is fantastic. Chem 230 is hard but Dr. Gottfried made a so much better! She has a lot of office hours. 5 exams are a bit too much but she is great!! 10/10 recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Gottfried is an absolutely phenomenal professor.  By far the best professor I have had here at the University of Mich.  Not only is Dr. Gottfried so incredibly kind and patient, it is also very clear she knows the material she is teaching inside and out

By far the best science/pre-med professor I've had at this university. While it's certainly difficult material, she explains it in the best/clearest way possible in the simplest terms. Practice problems adequately prepare you for the exams, all of which I found to be very fair and without any curveballs. Easy to tell she wants students to succeed.

I had Dr. Gottfried for chem 230 -- the class was difficult, lecture heavy and she made the work worth it. I was  always engaged in her class and she's incredibly nice to her students. It's one of those classes where you get out whatever you put in. Best professor at Umich imo

Dr. Gottfried is a great professor and her lectures are very clear and easy to understand. She is always willing to help students and answer any questions. The class does require a lot of work and some serious dedication to it, but all of the problems given help you understand or clarify the content. Would recommend taking with lighter classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I took Chem 130 asynchronously in Fall 2021 but Dr. Gottfried was the best lecturer by far and was great at answering questions so I always went to her office hours. She was very kind and genuinely interested in helping you understand concepts.

Absolutely ridiculous amount of work for a 3 credit class. 4 term exams and a cumulative final. 3 weekly quizzes and 3 homework assignments a week. I feel like i was scammed out of tuition money and hours. This class needs a serious rework. Dr. Gottfried is very caring but the class is abysmal.

Gottfried gives you everything you need to succeed - tons of PREP problems, office hours, clear module videos, relevant quizzes... etc. I ended up liking the flipped classroom setup!Expectations were clear and realistic. She solves problems really thoroughly and doesn't skip steps. She's also really sweet in general!

She is a great Professor who cares for every student and she explains the material in a great way so that students understand it. Of course, to get the grade you want, you have to practice constantly, but you would have a lot of feedback and resources !!!!!
Professor Gottfried was the best Chem 130 lecturer for the FA2021 semester. She explained concepts very clearly and was very easy to understand in her lectures.

Gottfried honestly was the better of the CHEM130 professor team. She does have a lot of care and compassion for her students and really wants to make a personal connection. The overall coursework is just far too expecting of the students. Most of us have not taken chemistry in several years and there is no room for error in this course.

She lacks empathy and sent out the most tasteless email calling it "bravery" to attend class during an active school shooter threat while the suspect isn't even in custody. She also counts attendance. During covid. She doesn't care about you at all, take someone else.

She is an amazing professor that explains hard topics so clearly and makes PCHEM not as hard. Her class is organized so well and it forces you to actually learn the material by giving so many practice problems and in class problem solving. One of the best professors at Michigan

Dr. Gottfried was the best lecturer for CHEM130. I found her to be the most clear and concise out of all the professors. She was also really helpful when I attended her office hours. The class is challenging, but having a good lecturer like her makes a difference.

Dr. Gottfried was an amazing prof! In a shortened semester, she explained things so well and was always available in OH or through Piazza to answer any questions you may have. Completely disagree with the people that say she only teaches basic conceptsall her exams are very doable; it just depends on if you are willing to put in the work.

Gottfried is really nice and has a great personality, and she never makes you feel dumb. But this was by far the WORST class I have ever taken -- just extremely hard. I had to put in so much time to get an A and never felt more relieved to finish a class. Would take a class with her again, but these topics are just so hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Gottfried is such a nice person and amazing at explaining problems and concepts so that they really "click". HOWEVER, for a 3 credit course the amount of homework, quizzes, pre-lecture videos and lecture team work, ON TOP of FIVE exams, was insane. I'm taking this class Pass/Fail since it's so hard to keep up with all the work.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Okay, this class is INSANELY HARD. There is a TON of homework and the exams are brutal. However, Gottfried is really great. She explains things clearly and genuinely cares about her students. She is just such a mom, she's so sweet and she definitely knows what she's talking about. In office hours, she is willing to go over anything multiple times.

Dr. Gottfried taught the material very clearly and you could tell she genuinely cared for her students even through the Zoom platform we used. A very well organized class. Not always the easiest, but Dr. Gottfried was always helpful.

Hardest premed class so far (haven't taken biochem yet tho). You basically have to sell your soul to the chemistry gods for the entire semester to get an A/A+ (but It is doable). IMMENSE amount of work for only 3 credits. She gives "improvement points" which is a massive boost. Tests are BRUTAL not just cuz of difficulty but EXTREME time pressure.

She's clear in explaining material and the course is really organized. She also gives plenty of practice problems in PREPP. These things are good. But this class is just an absurd amount of work for 3 credits. 5 tests + TOPS + PREPP + (optional) discussion + practice exams + modules + module homework is way too much, especially for online

On top of attending class to do mandatory TOPS (team based learning) we also have to spend a lot of time out of class watching lectures on our own, doing quizzes, and hw. I spend way too much time on this class for just 3 credits. Tests are really hard too, with lectures not being helpful.

I took this class and got an A. No thanks to gottfried though. I stopped watching the lectures after the first week when I realized she wasnt gonna teach anything beyond the most basic concepts. She leaves any and all difficult content to be learned alone. So I started reading her slides briefly before the exams and then doing the rest alone.

This class is made unnecessarily hard. All of the lecture material is info from AP chem and chem130 but the tests have concepts that are much harder. Basically had to pay full tuition for an online class that I had to teach to myself. I would think that a class that tested on hard material would actually teach that material instead of the basics.

CHEM230, aside from very basic problem solving on easy concepts, is pretty much a big trivia game. She tests on few practical concepts, choosing to instead make students remember a bunch of random pieces of trivia that would be looked up in any sane working environment. Logic questions are simple while most questions require worthless memorization

Every review about Dr. Gottfried here is accurate. Her exams are brutal and really test your ability to apply the hardest concepts to new scenarios. Her pre-TBL videos are very clearly taught, and her lecturing style is concise and truly beneficial. She is by far the best STEM professor I've had because she shows a genuine interest in her students.

Honestly pchem totally sucks and it is really hard, but Dr. Gottfried does a great job teaching the material and making you actively learn/practice. The TBL style class can be a lot of work and is a nightmare if you get behind, but I honestly felt like I learned a lot: Great clear videos to watch then having her to help w problems during lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Gottfried acknowledges that we all came into PChem expecting the worst, so she works very hard to help us succeed. I really enjoyed the TBL style just because it was more points if you had a bad test (which we did!) but she gives you an option to have it be 100% exam based if you don't want to go to class. GSIs were amazing! Go to office hours!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This is the most challenging class I have taken at Michigan. With that said, the work is incredibly rewarding and you will learn chemistry on a deep level. During the class you will be very frustrated at times, but when it is over there is a definite sense of pride and accomplishment for persevering. Make sure to do the PREP!

Dr. Gottfried is a great lecturer and she puts more time into helping students learn chemistry concepts than any other professor I've had. Lots of people are put off immediately by her exams but that's because they test your reading skills and ability to pull information out just as much as your chemistry knowledge but that's what the PREP is for.

PChem is a difficult class no doubt. But Dr. Gottfried is always very willing to answer questions, whether in office hours or on Piazza. Her tests are difficult, her coursepack is challenging, but I've learned so much from this experience. You will be trained to work really hard in this class and will be pushed to your limit but you will grow!
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She is one of the best lecturers I've had at this school. Her exams are pretty tough but she gives "improvement" extra credit points, you only need 75% on iClicker, and the class is a curved scale. She records OH and answers literally every single Piazza post. She really wants students to do well. MUST DO PREP SHE POSTS (w/ the key) TO DO WELL.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--Caring

reviews.comment: She's very approachable and her lectures are clear. Since there isn't really a textbook for this class, you have to make an effort to attend the lectures. The exams are pretty hard but she gives you a lot of resources (practice tests, etc.) to study from.

Lectures are elementary compared to her rigorous exams. I recommend NOT taking this with any other difficult courses. Despite providing a ton of great resources for practice and feedback, a large sum of time is dedicated to do well. Attendance isn't mandatory but clicker points can be used for those who don't want their grade to be 100% exam-based.

This class is the worst class I've ever endured. There are 7 extremely difficult exams, with the final being cumulative. Gottfried is a good lecturer, but her lecture material is extremely basic compared to her exams and she choses for it to be this way. The stress level created for this class is too much to handle for any student due to the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: The lectures cover at most 10% of the material on the exams, so most of exam preparation has to be done on your own. Homework is useless because it is not even 5% as difficult as the exam. By the way there are 7 exams for this one class! She explains material well after class but the exams always have new material that very few know how to solve.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: She's alright. Super nice and approachable, but this is honestly one of the hardest classes I've taken here. PREP is the only way to actually prepare for exams. I understand it's difficult to explain such complex concepts, but lectures often felt a bit barebones. You'll learn a lot, just be prepared to work

This course is difficult but there is no other instructor that I would have taken this class with except Dr. Gottfried. She is super approachable and really dedicated to helping you do well.
